(MarijuanaNews note: ABCNEWS has a very mixed track record on covering the marijuana issues.

and
ABC News Medical Writer Strongly Backs Medical Marijuana,
Blasts " the irresponsible, indefensible and unforgivable tactics
used to prevent people in severe pain from using marijuana as a medicine. "

With this appalling piece they follow the lead of a variety of major media outlets, most recently TIME Magazine. This really is not news, but rather stale prohibitionist propaganda.
See
Time Magazine Is Improving On The Party Line On " B. C. Bud. " Now it averages 30% THC! That is really B. S. Bud!
and links

None of them seem to think that there is any need for fact checking. So, not only is almost everything here incorrect, it actually contradicts readily available government data.

If I can find the facts, why is it that organizations as huge as ABCNEWS and TIME cannot?

Certainly, the Drug Czar did not need to waste the taxpayers’ money in paying the networks to run prohibitionist propaganda. Here they are getting it for free. Oddly, the ABCNEWS anchor, Peter Jennings, is a Canadian.

By the way, I have never heard the terms " super marijuana " or " rocket ship marijuana " used by any of my numerous friends in the Canadian marijuana business.

The narks do everything possible to promote the Canadian business so they can extend the DEAland police state into Canada. Of course, in the meantime, my friends don’t mind the extra publicity.

Marijuana prohibition creates an odd symbiosis between the narks and the growers.)

From ABCNEWS.com
http://abcnews.go.com/onair/WorldNewsTonight/wnt000530_CanadianPot_feature.html
(MarijuanaNews note: You can watch the actual report – which is a little different from the printed article – by clicking on the video icon on the page.)
By Tom Foreman
(MarijuanaNews note: Foreman won an Emmy for his reporting – on another subject. For this one he wins my Reefer Madness award.)

May 30 — It is a moonless night on the United States-Canadian border and Bob Bonbright of the U.S. Border Patrol is searching. His target is smugglers bringing in the highest grade marijuana ever seen in the U.S.

 " It’s a damn good business, " says Bonbright, pointing at the border in the dark. " I mean, you’re looking at Canada just right through there. "

It’s easy for drug traffickers to come across the border in thousands of places. " And they do it, " Bonbright says, " night and day. "

The so-called Super Marijuana

, which is grown in and around Vancouver, is very valuable: a little more than two pounds, worth $1,800 in Canada, will bring in $5,000 in Washington state and $10,000 in Los Angeles, a price comparable to cocaine.
(MarijuanaNews note: Not even close.)
See
RCMP Annual Report On the " Drug Situation in Canada " Contradicts Staples Of the Prohibitionist Party Line. Exclusive To MarijuanaNews.

Authorities believe it has turned marijuana farming here into a billion-dollar-a-year industry.

" Right now, the marijuana that is out there being grown in British Columbia is what we usually call ‘rocket ship marijuana,’ " says Pete Thompson, of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police. " This has no parallel to the marijuana from the late 60s and early 70s. "
(MarijuanaNews note: Of course, the party line. There is no data on THC levels from the 60’s, so that is a major clue that no one cares enough to do any fact checking.)
See
Canadian Police Lie to The Canadian Media Who Lie To Their Readers
To Justify More Power Over the Canadian People To Please DEAland Narks
An Utterly Wretched Piece Of Pseudo-journalism
and
Potent Pot Myth Undermined By Report From The Ultimate Authority. Cited By Swedish Prohibitionist Who Don’t Seem To Understand. As Usual.
and links

Most of the high-grade marijuana is cultivated indoors in conditions that make it six times more potent than average. Although marijuana is illegal in Canada, possession and use are widely tolerated. U.S. officials charge that smuggling has grown because producers have little to fear in Canada.

" As long as you have the continued discrepancy in enforcement between Canada and the United States, " says Rep. Lamar Smith, R-Texas, " you’re going to continue to have these kinds of problems. "
(MarijuanaNews note: One of the appalling people who govern us, Smith is a police-state Republican, but even he should know that DEAland grows far more marijuana than Canada. According to the DEA, half the marijuana consumed in DEAland is domestically grown, so clearly high penalties are not an effective deterrent.

The Canadians know this and they are not going to wreck the lives of their citizens and overcrowd their prisons just to appease DEAland, and the Canadian narks.

See
Poll Shows B.C. Residents Reject DEAland Pressure To Increase Penalties on Marijuana Growing.

On e bit of real news, that escaped mention here is that Smith’s effort to cripple Canadian border traffic, has failed. The Congress repealed a law that Smith sponsored that would have made cross-border traffic a nightmare. DEAland merchants and manufacturers pressured the Congress to repeal it before it went into effect.)


Canadian authorities have raided substantially more growing operations this year than last, but there is so much marijuana and so much open border.

Guards on both sides believe they are intercepting only about 2 percent of the super marijuana that smugglers are bringing into the U.S. every night.
(MarijuanaNews note: If that is true, then Canadian marijuana represents only a tiny fraction of the DEAland marijuana market.)
See
RCMP Report On Marijuana Trafficking Contradicts The Party Line
About Marijuana Smuggling From Canada To DEAland. Far More Goes North Than South
